en.title: Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross
en.meditation:
Consider how, after the death of our Lord, two of His disciples, Joseph and Nicodemus, took Him down from the Cross, and placed Him in the arms of His afflicted Mother, who received Him with unutterable tenderness, and pressed Him to her bosom.

O Mother of sorrow, for the love of this Son, accept me for thy servant, and pray to Him for me. And Thou, my Redeemer, since Thou hast died for me, permit me to love Thee; for I wish but Thee, and nothing more. I love Thee, my Jesus, and I repent of ever having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Jésus est descendu de la croix
fr.meditation:
Considérons comment, après la mort du Seigneur, deux de ses disciples : Joseph et Nicodème, le descendent de la croix et le remettent entre les bras de la Très Sainte Vierge, sa Mère affligée qu’accompagnait saint Jean.

O mon divin Rédempteur, à l’exemple de Votre Sainte Mère, faites que j’aie le courage de participer à Votre sacrifice de réparation pour le salut des âmes, en prenant part aux bonnes œuvres et en faisant quelques pénitences.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
fr.source: spiritualite-chretienne.com, "Chemin de Croix avec les meditations de St Alphonse de Liguori" (site now defunct/repurposed; archived via Wayback Machine, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20200221112546/http://www.spiritualite-chretienne.com/croix/stat-c01.html), retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (meditation); Diocese de Saint-Etienne (diocese-saintetienne.fr), "Chemin de Croix", https://www.diocese-saintetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Chemin-de-croix.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (versicle/response)
